entries.title: I Chronicles 17:1
segments: As David sat in his house; for the exposition of this chapter, see the notes on

. 
 
A godly man is not content merely to receive blessings himself, but wishes to do all he can for the honor of God and the good of mankind.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:7
segments: The elevation of rulers is from God; and the higher they are raised in power and influence, the greater is their obligation to love and serve him, and the greater will be their guilt, and the more dreadful their condemnation, if they rebel against him.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:16
segments: The goodness of God to his people deeply humbles them on account of their unworthiness, and leads them to feel that for all their mercies they are indebted to the riches of his grace.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:24
segments: The righteous wish to have the promises of God fulfilled, not merely that it may be well with them, but that he may be glorified, and multitudes be led to adore him for ever.
